deadlineNote: Master's 2nd committee. Master's 1st committee was 18 Oct 2026; Bachelor's (foreign school) 13 Jan 2027.
name: Emile Boutmy Scholarship
summary: Tuition exemption at Sciences Po for first-time applicants from outside the EU: full or 9,500 EUR for a Bachelor's first year, or 18,500 EUR per year for a two-year Master's.
eligibilityNotes: Page requires a non-EU state and a household not taxed in the EU; EU states, Switzerland and Norway expanded to codes as exclusions (also EU dual citizens). Amount depends on level and package, so it is left empty. PhD, 1-year Master's and exchange students excluded.

deadlineNote: 2026 cycle closed (31 March 2026); next dates not yet published.
covers: travel and visa flat fee (up to 900 EUR)
name: Université Paris-Saclay International Master's Scholarship
summary: 10,000 EUR per year, paid monthly from September to June, plus up to 900 EUR for travel and visa, for foreign students admitted to a Paris-Saclay Master's. For students new to French higher education.
eligibilityNotes: Page says foreign nationality; French excluded. Must be under 30, new to French higher education, and receive no other funding above 600 EUR a month. Not combinable with Eiffel, Europa or Erasmus Mundus. Page does not say if tuition is covered.

deadlineNote: Campus France pages give both 6 and 8 January 2027; institutions set earlier internal deadlines (for example 20 Nov 2026 at Strasbourg).
name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs, run by Campus France
summary: Monthly allowance of 1,200 EUR (Master's) or 2,100 EUR (PhD) with travel, insurance and housing help for foreign students. Only French institutions can nominate candidates; tuition is not covered.
eligibilityNotes: Campus France page does not list nationalities; university pages (Strasbourg, Cote d'Azur) say foreign nationals only, French dual nationals excluded. Master's age 29 or under, PhD 35 or under; not currently studying in France. Allowance differs by level, so amount is left empty.

deadlineNote: Applications run April to May each year; currently closed.
name: Université Côte d'Azur IdEx Scholarship for International MSc Programs
summary: Tuition exemption plus a 5,000 EUR stipend for one year, for ten top applicants to eleven international MSc programs at Côte d'Azur.
eligibilityNotes: Page says any nationality. Must apply to an eligible MSc first; current Côte d'Azur students are excluded; cannot be combined with other scholarships.

deadlineNote: No separate deadline; follow each eligible programme's application dates.
name: Aix-Marseille TIGER Master's Excellence Scholarship
summary: Up to 10,000 EUR for one academic year plus a reserved CROUS room for strong Master's students in eligible programmes. No separate application; programme coordinators choose winners.
eligibilityNotes: Page speaks of profiles from all over the world and sets no nationality rule; it does not say whether French nationals are excluded. Amount is a maximum. Only listed programmes qualify.

name: Tahtawi Scholarship (Sciences Po)
summary: Helps Egyptian students entering the second year of a Sciences Po Master's with living expenses.
eligibilityNotes: Egyptian students only, entering year two of a Master's. Amount and deadline are not on the page.

name: Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Scholarship (Sciences Po)
summary: Scholarship for Saudi students admitted to a Sciences Po Bachelor's, Master's or PhD.
eligibilityNotes: Saudi students only. Amount, coverage and deadline are not on the page.

name: French Embassy in Iran Scholarship (Sciences Po)
provider: Sciences Po with the French Embassy in Iran
summary: Scholarship for Iranian students living in Iran who are admitted to a Sciences Po Master's.
eligibilityNotes: Iranian students living in Iran only. Amount, coverage and deadline are not on the page.

name: France Excellence Charpak Scholarship (listed by Sciences Po)
summary: Scholarship run by the French Embassy in India for Indian students studying in France at undergraduate or postgraduate level.
eligibilityNotes: Indian students only. Sciences Po page says undergraduate or postgraduate; PhD not confirmed so not listed. Facts come from Sciences Po's summary, so confirm with the embassy page.
